title: configure-module input
description: Configuration payload for MDTeam Workspace on NethServer 8.

host.description: Fully qualified domain name routed via Traefik (e.g. mdteam.example.org)

http2https.description: Redirect HTTP requests automatically to HTTPS

lets_encrypt.description: Request an automatic Let's Encrypt TLS certificate via Traefik

ldap_domain.description: Optional NethServer 8 user domain name (OpenLDAP or Samba AD); empty string disables LDAP

ldap_default_role.description: Default Scrum role assigned to authenticated domain users without a specific group match

ldap_admin_group.description: LDAP/AD group name mapped to the MDTeam 'admin' role

ldap_po_group.description: LDAP/AD group name mapped to the MDTeam 'product-owner' role

ldap_sm_group.description: LDAP/AD group name mapped to the MDTeam 'scrum-master' role

ldap_stakeholder_group.description: LDAP/AD group name mapped to the MDTeam 'stakeholder' role

admin_password.description: Optional initial or updated password for the local 'admin' account

initial_password.description: Optional alias for admin_password when configuring via CLI
